subject.title: [Feature]: Open bot-inclusive Slack group DMs from App Home

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin ship a native App Home MPIM opener that lets a DM-authorized creator create group-scoped agent access for selected Slack users?
rationale: The feature is plugin-owned and aligned with Slack channel UX, but it introduces user-triggered conversation creation and group-scoped access semantics that automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve bounded App Home opener after proof
options.body: Allow the feature if it keeps existing DM/group-DM gates, clearly explains no history transfer, and adds redacted live Slack create/reopen proof before merge.

options.title: Require stricter member authorization
options.body: Ask for a revised design that checks selected members or adds an explicit opt-in policy before a creator can grant group-scoped access.

options.title: Keep docs and workarounds only
options.body: Do not add native MPIM creation now and continue directing users to private-channel conversion or external conversations.open usage.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded App Home opener after proof
recommendation.body: Allow the feature if it keeps existing DM/group-DM gates, clearly explains no history transfer, and adds redacted live Slack create/reopen proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the current Slack App Home handler and adjacent MPIM gating history, making them the best routing candidate for the product/security-boundary decision.
